saṅkoca.p: [ saṃ + kuca + ṇa. ] (ti) CL=8 Nīti, dhātu. 30 - 1. Saṃkoca - saṃ. Saṃkoa - prā ]   (1)who is lazy and demoralized; he . (Pu) (2)  shrinkage and contraction. (3) Laziness. (1) See the article below.

P: Saṅkoca，[saṁ+koca，of kuñc： see kuñcita] contraction （as a sign of anger or annoyance），grimace （mukha°） PvA．103； also as hattha°，etc．at PvA．124．（Page 663）
R:
saṅkoca：သငေ်္ကာစ （ပ） （သံ√ကုစ်+ဏ）

saṅkoceti.p: [ saṃ + kuca + ṇe + ti . ] ( kā,kri) CL=8 Saṃkocayati-saṃ. ]  It makes you hesitate.

C: saṅkoceti：[saṃ + kuc + e] contracts or distorts．
P: Saṅkoceti，[Caus．of saṅkucati] to contract J．I，228； DhsA．324．（Page 663）
R:

မာ စိတ္တံ သံကောစယိတ္ထ၊ စိတ်ကို မတွန့်တိုစေလင့်။

saṅkocita.cp: pp. of saṅkoceti. contracted or distorted.
saṅkocita.p: [ saṃ + kuca + ta. ] (ti) CL=8 Nīti, dhātu. 30 - 1. Saṃkocita - saṃ. Saṃkoiya - prā ] (1) contract. (2) should be folded and roll up.

saṅkocana.p: [ saṃ + kuca + yu. ] (na) CL=8 Nīti, dhātu. 30 - 1. Saṃkocana - saṃ. Saṃkoaṇa - prā. Saṃkoyaṇa - addhamādhī ]  (1) shortness of breath (2) Bending-folding and twisting. (1) Saṅkocana - paccuppaṭṭhāna  - See.

saṅkocetvā.p: [ saṃ + kuca + ṇe + tvā ] (kā, kri, vi) CL=8 to bend and roll up (or) curl up.

saṅkopa.p: [ saṃ, kupa + ṇe + ṇa.] (pu) CL=8 Nīti, dhātu. 235. ] to be demage (or) destroy.
